author: IcyCode
body:
Hi Guys,
New submission for CTH. Named Arbaro. If any of you can find what the name means and what language it is I will be very impressed :D Anyway we have created a jungle theme with a unique CTH gameplay that is not on any other map. We have a boardwalk going across with a jump spot going into the hill from above. Although the map is simple it required weeks of work for completion as we made it from scratch with most of the jobs done was without worldedit. We thought that Control The Hill should have a place that looks like a hill so that is what we have created.
Update 1.7 Log:
  • Glass Dome has gone
  • Made the center tree look better.
  • Added loads of hills round the edge of request from Evocal
  • Made the bridges look nicer
  • General Improvements
Details below on map below:
Creators:
                           
subzero110       samthemenace
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/5hyw31q584822dj
Picture Gallery: http://imgur.com/a/239mD
I hope you like it as it has taken alot of time :D
Updated it hopefully it will be used for a ME update soon as it is already accepted :P
See you guys around,
subzero110

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
Here's a tip : First of all, you should add the four beacons in the middle, which determine where the area where you collect points is.
Secondly, the bridges need to be a bit more detailed. The bridges are just jungle planks with fences on them. Try making them a bit less blocky, and use a wider variety of blocks. Evocal is very good with choosing blocks that go well with each other, so try asking him on skype for some combinations. 
Thirdly, there is very little room to walk around on. The picture with the vines on the tree leading to the bridges (the fourth picture) shows that there is only a one block area to walk on when you get to the top.
Try making it a bit bigger and more spacey.
Also, play around with the bridge designs a bit, make them more fun.
I hope this helped you, I'm not saying that your map is bad, I'm just trying to help you.
Good luck.
